summary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group furnished a Form 6-K on September 18, 2026, attaching Japanese and U.S. counsel legal opinions for a multi-tranche senior notes offering: $400 million callable floating rate notes due 2032, $750 million 5.126% notes due 2030, $850 million 5.437% notes due 2032, $750 million 5.625% notes due 2034 and $750 million 6.205% notes due 2047, sold under a September 8, 2026 underwriting agreement. This is an ordinary shelf takedown of registered debt securities, not a special situation; no equity stake, premium or board recommendation is involved. Watch only funding conditions and credit spreads.
